# persian-date-native — Universal Persian & Jalali Date Engine

> Fast, zero-dependency Persian (Jalali / Solar Hijri / Shamsi) date engine for JavaScript and TypeScript with browser script tags, CDN, React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Svelte, jQuery, WordPress, Laravel, and Day.js plugin support.

## Key Links
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/muhamadzolfaghari/persian-date-native
- **NPM Package**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/persian-date-native
- **Live Online Tools & Calendar**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/persian-date-native/
- **Interactive Framework Examples**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/persian-date-native/examples.html
- **Full LLM Reference**: https://muhamadzolfaghari.github.io/persian-date-native/llms-full.txt

## Quick Install & CDN
- `npm install persian-date-native`
- `<script src="https://unpkg.com/persian-date-native"></script>`

## Summary Comparison
- **Dependencies**: 0 (Zero runtime dependencies)
- **Object Inheritance**: Subclasses native `Date` (`instanceof Date === true`)
- **Conversion Performance**: 38.8M ops/sec (gregorianToPersian), 22.5M ops/sec (persianToGregorian)
- **Bundle Size**: 5.70 KB Gzip (ESM / CJS / Browser Global / UMD)
- **1403 Leap Year**: Correctly handles 1403 as leap year (30 days in Esfand 1403) and 1404 as 29 days.
